title: Inter-run agreement and reliability — agent_agreement
text: statistics textbook nominal-agreement measures; weight, threshold scoring rule invented . Overall percent agreement mean across cases per-case pairwise agreement \(P_i\), proportion rater pairs assigned case \(\) category. \(m\) repeats \(n_{ij}\) repeats placing case \(\) category \(j\), $$P_i = \frac{1}{m(m-1)} \left( \sum_j n_{ij}^2 - m \right),$$ per-subject agreement Fleiss (1971). two repeats simply fraction cases returned verdict times. Cohen's kappa reported exactly two repeats (Cohen, 1960). observed agreement \(p_o\) (share cases whose two verdicts match) expected agreement \(p_e = \sum_j p_{1j} p_{2j}\) formed repeat's category marginals \(p_{1j}, p_{2j}\), $$\kappa = \frac{p_o - p_e}{1 - p_e}.$$ Fleiss' kappa reported three repeats (Fleiss, 1971). mean observed agreement \(\bar P = \frac{1}{n}\sum_i P_i\) expected agreement \(\bar P_e = \sum_j p_j^2\) pooled category proportions \(p_j = \frac{1}{nm}\sum_i n_{ij}\), $$\kappa = \frac{\bar P - \bar P_e}{1 - \bar P_e}.$$ Fleiss' form treats repeats interchangeable, repeated runs one agent ; Cohen's form, used two, keeps repeat's marginals separate. every verdict falls one category expected agreement 1, kappa \(0/0\) returned `NA`: variation correct , chance-corrected statistic nothing say. `strength` label follows rule thumb Landis & Koch (1977) (< 0 "poor", 0–0.20 "slight", 0.21–0.40 "fair", 0.41–0.60 "moderate", 0.61–0.80 "substantial", 0.81–1 "almost perfect"). published guideline, quoted orientation ; package enforces kappa threshold label changes score verdict.

title: Inter-run agreement and reliability — agent_agreement
text: Cohen, J. (1960). coefficient agreement nominal scales. Educational Psychological Measurement, 20(1), 37–46. Fleiss, J. L. (1971). Measuring nominal scale agreement among many raters. Psychological Bulletin, 76(5), 378–382. Landis, J. R. & Koch, G. G. (1977). measurement observer agreement categorical data. Biometrics, 33(1), 159–174.

title: Inter-run agreement and reliability — agent_agreement
code: suite <- agent_suite(list(   agent_case("steady", "ping", "ok", slice = "stable", grader = "contains"),   agent_case("flaky", "toggle", "ok", slice = "shaky", severity = "high",              grader = "contains") )) # A deterministic offline runner that flips one case's answer every other call. seen <- new.env() flip <- function(x) {   n <- if (exists(x, seen, inherits = FALSE)) get(x, seen) else 0L   assign(x, n + 1L, seen)   if (x == "toggle" && (n + 1L) %% 2L == 0L) "no" else "ok" } run <- run_benchmark(suite, flip, repeats = 4L, quiet = TRUE) ag <- agent_agreement(run) ag #>  #> ── Inter-run agreement: 2 cases over 4 runs ──────────────────────────────────── #> Categories seen: "fail" and "pass" #> Percent agreement: 0.6667 (mean pairwise) #> Fleiss' kappa: 0.1111 (slight), expected 0.6250 #>  #> ── Cases where runs disagree most  #> flaky (shaky, high) agreement 0.3333, 2 verdicts #>  #> Strength label follows Landis & Koch (1977); it changes no score or verdict. ag$by_item #>       id  slice severity n_runs distinct modal agreement #> 1  flaky  shaky     high      4        2  fail    0.3333 #> 2 steady stable   medium      4        1  pass    1.0000

text: agent_agreement() reports inter-run reliability run repeats: overall percent agreement (mean pairwise), Cohen’s kappa two runs Fleiss’ kappa three , per-case breakdown ordered least-agreeing cases first. consistency() gives raw disagreement rate score_confidence() bounds single run’s score, chance-corrected agreement across repeated runs. Textbook formulas (Cohen 1960, Fleiss 1971) Landis & Koch (1977) strength label cited help; calls model changes score verdict. score_confidence() puts Wilson confidence interval per-slice score, slice three passing cases (point score 1.0) longer read slice three hundred. Supply thresholds reports whether point score clears bar whether even lower bound ; slice clears point estimate lower bound cases claim. interval closed form, deterministic offline, function changes score verdict: readiness() unchanged. diff_runs() now lists regressions -severe first. ordered severity string, sorts alphabetically pushed failed critical case bottom list instead top. suite_audit() lints r4agent_suite coverage quality gaps: families severities cases, slices minimum case count, cases stated , absence abstention injection coverage. findings advisory, carry severity change score verdict; audit never runs suite calls model. write_agent_suite() serialises r4agent_suite back YAML read_agent_suite() reads, suite built R round-trips file. case whose grader function serialised: kept every field warning names , grader falls default re-read. consistency_strata() reports run--run instability broken slice severity, unstable slice, instability concentrated critical cases, visible rather averaged one flat rate. existing consistency() output unchanged. agent_suite() now accepts bare cases (agent_suite(case1, case2)) well list cases, documentation already stated; previously bare case spliced fields rejected. title: r4agent 0.1.0
text: Initial release. agent_suite(), agent_case(), agent_thresholds() read_agent_suite() define benchmark suite: cases expected answer, slice severity, plus slice thresholds agreed run. run_benchmark() runs agent language model suite score_slices() grades results locally deterministically, model called judge another model. readiness() returns production readiness answer, consistency() checks run--run stability, diff_runs() surfaces case used pass now fails instead averaging away. agent_evidence() emits results R4SUB evidence rows via ‘r4subcore’, report_markdown() writes shareable report. register_grader() graders_available() expose pluggable, offline grader interface.
